name: Voltaire Pro 16 Laptop
short_description: 16-inch 4K OLED creator laptop with a 14-core CPU and 32 GB of unified memory.
description: Built for people who render, compile and edit all day. The Voltaire Pro 16 pairs a 14-core processor with 32 GB of unified memory and a 16-inch 4K OLED panel calibrated to 100% DCI-P3. Sustained performance under load is handled by a dual vapour-chamber cooling system that stays under 38 dB.

name: Voltaire Air 13
short_description: A 1.1 kg fanless ultrabook that runs 20 hours on a charge.
description: The Air 13 is the laptop you forget is in your bag. Completely fanless, 1.1 kg, and rated for 20 hours of mixed use. The magnesium-alloy chassis is cold-forged in one piece, so there is no flex in the keyboard deck.

name: Surge Gaming Rig 17
short_description: 17-inch 240 Hz gaming laptop with a desktop-class GPU and per-key RGB.
description: A 17-inch 240 Hz QHD display, a desktop-class GPU with a 175 W power envelope, and a mechanical per-key RGB keyboard with 1.9 mm of travel. The chassis takes air from four intakes and exhausts through the rear, so your hands stay off the hot zone.

name: Pulse 9 Pro
short_description: Titanium flagship with a 1-inch main sensor and 5x periscope zoom.
description: The Pulse 9 Pro puts a 1-inch type main sensor behind an f/1.6 lens, with a 5x periscope telephoto that stays usable indoors. The frame is grade-5 titanium, and the 6.8-inch LTPO panel drops to 1 Hz when you are reading.

specs.camera: 50 MP 1" main, 48 MP ultrawide, 64 MP 5x periscope

name: Pulse 9
short_description: The flagship chip in a 6.2-inch body that fits one hand.
description: Same Fusion 9 silicon as the Pro in a 6.2-inch frame. You give up the periscope lens and the titanium; you keep the processor, the 120 Hz panel and seven years of OS updates.

name: Pulse Fold 4
short_description: Book-style foldable with a crease-free 7.9-inch inner display.
description: A water-drop hinge with no visible crease, rated for 400,000 folds. Open it to a 7.9-inch 120 Hz panel; closed, the 6.4-inch cover screen runs every app unchanged.

name: Resonance ANC Over-Ear
short_description: Reference over-ears with adaptive noise cancelling and 60-hour battery.
description: Two feed-forward and two feed-back microphones per cup drive an adaptive cancellation loop that re-measures the seal 48,000 times a second. 60 hours with ANC on, and a 5-minute charge gives you 5 hours.

name: Resonance Buds Pro
short_description: True-wireless buds with per-ear hearing calibration.
description: A 12-second tone sweep builds a hearing profile for each ear and the buds EQ to it. Dual-driver design, 9 hours per charge, 32 with the case.

name: Basswave Studio Monitors (Pair)
short_description: 5-inch active near-field monitors with room correction built in.
description: Bi-amped 5-inch monitors with a measurement microphone in the box. Run the sweep once and the onboard DSP corrects for your room's first reflections. Flat to within 1.5 dB from 48 Hz to 22 kHz.

specs.driver: 5" woven glass-fibre woofer, 1" silk dome tweeter
specs.amplifier: 80 W LF + 50 W HF per cabinet

name: Basswave Portable Boom
short_description: IP67 portable speaker, 24-hour battery, stereo pairing.
description: A 24-hour portable that survives being dropped in a pool. Two passive radiators give it low end that a speaker this size should not have, and you can pair two for true stereo.

specs.features: Stereo pairing, USB-C power out, app EQ

name: Chrono Fit 3
short_description: Health watch with ECG, skin temperature and a 9-day battery.
description: Medical-grade ECG, continuous skin-temperature sensing and overnight blood-oxygen tracking, all on a 9-day battery. Sapphire crystal over a 1.5-inch always-on AMOLED.

specs.sensors: ECG, SpO2, skin temperature, optical HR

name: Chrono Trail Ultra
short_description: Titanium multisport watch with 100-hour GPS and offline topo maps.
description: Built for events that outlast other watches. 100 hours of dual-band GPS, full offline topographic maps on 32 GB of storage, and a titanium bezel over a sapphire lens. The 100-lumen flashlight is brighter than it sounds.

name: Lumina 65" OLED Evo
short_description: 65-inch 4K OLED, 144 Hz, 1500 nits peak with a micro-lens array.
description: A micro-lens array pushes this panel to 1500 nits peak without losing OLED's perfect blacks. Four HDMI 2.1 ports all do 4K144 with VRR, so every console and PC gets the good port.

name: Lumina 55" QLED Mini-LED
short_description: 55-inch mini-LED with 1,152 dimming zones and 2000 nits peak.
description: 1,152 independently dimmed mini-LED zones and 2000 nits of peak brightness, which is what you want in a room with windows. 120 Hz native with VRR on two of the four HDMI ports.

name: Aperture X1 Mirrorless Body
short_description: Full-frame 45 MP stacked sensor, 8K60 raw video, 8-stop stabilisation.
description: A 45 MP stacked full-frame sensor reading out fast enough for 8K60 internal raw and 40 fps blackout-free stills. In-body stabilisation is rated at 8 stops, and the AF subject recognition covers people, animals, birds and vehicles.

name: Aperture 24-70mm f/2.8 Lens
short_description: Constant f/2.8 standard zoom with dual linear focus motors.
description: The lens that lives on the camera. Constant f/2.8 across the range, two linear motors for silent focus pulls in video, and weather sealing at eleven points. 695 g, which is light for the class.

name: Aperture Action 5
short_description: Pocket action camera, 5.3K60, waterproof to 12 m without a case.
description: 5.3K60 with horizon levelling that holds through a full barrel roll, and it is waterproof to 12 m with no housing. The front screen means you can frame yourself without guessing.

name: Nexus Console Ultra
short_description: 4K120 console with a 2 TB SSD and hardware ray tracing.
description: Targets 4K120 with hardware ray tracing and loads most titles in under three seconds off its 2 TB custom SSD. The controller has adaptive triggers and the whole thing stays under 30 dB in quiet scenes.

name: Nexus Handheld Go
short_description: 7-inch 120 Hz OLED handheld that plays your whole PC library.
description: A 7-inch 120 Hz OLED handheld with hall-effect sticks that will never drift. Runs a desktop OS, so your existing library works, and the 55 Wh battery gives 3 to 8 hours depending on what you ask of it.

name: Nexus Pro Controller
short_description: Hall-effect pro controller with swappable sticks and back paddles.
description: Hall-effect sticks, four back paddles, swappable stick heights and a 1000 Hz polling rate over its own 2.4 GHz dongle. Profiles live on the controller, so they follow you between machines.

name: Hearth Smart Hub Display
short_description: 10-inch smart display that runs automations locally.
description: A 10-inch hub with Matter and Thread radios that keeps your automations running when the internet does not. The camera has a physical shutter, and the microphone has a hardware mute switch, not a software one.

specs.radios: Matter, Thread border router, Zigbee, Wi-Fi 6E
specs.privacy: Hardware microphone mute, local automation engine

name: Hearth Doorbell Cam 2K
short_description: 2K doorbell with on-device person detection and local storage.
description: Person, package and vehicle detection all run on the doorbell itself, so no video leaves your network unless you ask it to. 2K at a 1:1 aspect ratio shows you the parcel on the step, not just the visitor's face.

specs.storage: Local microSD up to 512 GB, optional cloud

name: Voltcell 140 W GaN Charger
short_description: Four-port 140 W GaN charger smaller than a deck of cards.
description: 140 W across four ports with intelligent allocation, in a third-generation GaN package that is smaller than the 96 W brick it replaces. Charges a 16-inch laptop and three other devices at once.

name: Voltcell 27K Power Bank
short_description: 27,000 mAh bank with a 140 W output and a built-in display.
description: 27,000 mAh, which is the largest capacity you can take through airport security, with a 140 W output that recharges a laptop properly. The display tells you actual watts and remaining minutes rather than four vague bars.

name: Voltcell Thunder Dock 14-in-1
short_description: Thunderbolt dock driving three 4K displays and 96 W upstream charging.
description: One cable for three 4K60 displays, 2.5 Gb Ethernet, an SD reader and 96 W back to the laptop. The aluminium shell is the heatsink, so there is no fan.

name: Voltcell Mechanical Keyboard 75
short_description: Gasket-mounted 75% board, hot-swappable, with south-facing RGB.
description: A gasket-mounted 75% layout with five layers of damping, so it sounds like a thock rather than a rattle. Hot-swappable sockets take three- and five-pin switches, and the knob is remappable per layer.
